description: OpenWrt's dnsmasq, over SSH and UCI.

address.description: The router, with a port unless it's 22.

host_key.description: The fingerprint of the host's SSH key, as ssh-keygen -l shows it: SHA256:.... Any of its keys works. Recommended: without it, any key is accepted, and the log warns with the fingerprint it saw.

zone.description: The zone of the names, as lan.

ttl.description: Not used: dnsmasq's records have no TTL of their own. Accepted so that configurations that set it still load.
